title: 第1章 风起之时第2章 劫修
content_zh:
“下一位——楚王镇，楚无忌。”
小玄岛管事一身青袍，嗓音虽不高，但硬生生把队伍里那阵窃窃私语压了下去。
楚无忌抬起头，视线一瞬间有些发虚。
他脑子里还停留在“刚才”——仿佛一眨眼的恍惚，前一刻还是迎面而来的大运，下一刻便站在这条等待测灵的队列里，耳边全是陌生人的低语。
楚无忌晃了晃脑袋，前身的记忆碎片仍在脑海中翻涌。
“星宫......”
“正道巨擘万法门......附庸势力青玄门......”
“星宫？！这里是凡人修仙传中的人界，乱星海！”
作为熟读原著之人，他几乎不需再多思索，就已经确认了这个残酷的现实。
他穿越到了凡人的世界，并且穿越成了一名再寻常不过的凡人孩童。
“就是不知道现在是什么时间线，韩老魔飞升前，还是飞升后？”
凡人修仙传中修仙界的风气可不太好，杀人夺宝屡见不鲜，而且太多老六，阴谋诡计更是家常便饭。
更要命的是，不知是谁把修仙界的风气带歪了，越阶杀敌竟成了常态：筑基打练气，结丹压练气，元婴灭结丹，化神装练气。
“无忌。”旁边的妇人揪着衣角，声音压得极低，却还是藏不住颤意。
“进去后别乱看。听仙师的话，让你做什么就做什么。”
旁边的中年男人喉咙动了动，压着声音：“成不成……都别慌，记住了吗？”
他又补了一句，像是说给孩子听，更像是说给自己听。
“不成也不打紧，仙家那条路，不是咱这种人能走的。能平平安安活着，娶个媳妇，生个大胖小子，这辈子也就够了......”
楚无忌下意识地点头。
他深吸一口气，迈开才六七岁的小腿，朝那扇石门走去。

管事侧身让开，扫了他一眼，早见惯了这种紧张，语气平平：“进去。”
石门开出一道缝，淡淡檀香从里面溢出来。
楚无忌跨过门槛。
“轰——”
石门合拢，人群的喧闹声瞬间被隔绝在外。
密室中央，一只测灵盘静静悬浮。
盘面古旧，符纹交错，散发着微弱的五彩光晕。
旁侧，一名练气仙师端坐蒲团上，闭目打坐，神情淡漠，浅蓝色长袍一尘不染。
“手，放上去。”
仙师并未睁眼，淡淡说了句，又微微抬了抬下巴，示意他把手按在测灵盘上。
楚无忌走近一步，伸出手臂，把手掌贴在测灵盘上。
一股冰凉气息自掌心钻入。
“静心引气，将灵气重新引导入盘。”
仙师淡淡道，“别紧张，越紧张越慢。”
楚无忌喉咙发紧：“我……我不会。”
仙师终于睁眼，半阖着的目光落在他脸上，明显嫌麻烦：“照我说的做：想着你胸口有一口气，顺着手臂走到掌心，送回去。”
content_en:
"The next one is Chu Wangzhen, Chu Wuji."
The steward of Xiaoxuan Island was dressed in a green robe. Although his voice was not high, he suppressed the whispers in the team.
Chu Wuji raised his head, his vision blurred for a moment.
His mind was still stuck on "just now" - as if he was in a trance in the blink of an eye. One moment he was facing great luck, and the next moment he was standing in a queue waiting for a spiritual test, and his ears were filled with the whispers of strangers.
Chu Wuji shook his head, fragments of memories from his previous life still surging in his mind.
"Star Palace..."
"The righteous giant Wanfamen...the vassal force Qingxuanmen..."
"Star Palace?! This is the human world in the legend of mortals cultivating immortals, the sea of chaotic stars!"
As someone who is familiar with the original work, he has already confirmed this cruel reality without any further thought.
He traveled to the mortal world and became an ordinary mortal child.
"I just don't know what timeline it is now, before Old Demon Han ascended, or after he ascended?"
In Mortal Cultivation of Immortality, the atmosphere in the world of immortality is not very good. Killing people and seizing treasures are common. There are too many old men, and conspiracy and conspiracy are commonplace.
What's even worse is that I don't know who has distorted the atmosphere of the world of immortality. Killing enemies across levels has become the norm: building the foundation to practice Qi, forming pills to suppress Qi, Yuanying to destroy the pills, and transforming into gods to practice Qi.
"Wuji." The woman next to her tugged at the corner of her clothes, her voice was very low, but she still couldn't hide her trembling.
"Don't look around after you go in. Listen to the immortal master and do whatever he asks you to do."
The middle-aged man next to him moved his throat and suppressed his voice: "Is it possible or not...don't panic, remember?"
He added another sentence, as if he was speaking to his children, more like he was speaking to himself.
"It doesn't matter if it doesn't happen. The path of the Immortal family is not for people like us. If we can live peacefully, marry a wife, and have a fat boy, this life is enough..."
Chu Wuji nodded subconsciously.
He took a deep breath, stepped on his six or seven-year-old calves, and walked towards the stone door.
The steward stepped aside and glanced at him. He was used to this kind of nervousness, and said in a calm tone: "Go in."
There was a crack in the stone door, and a faint scent of sandalwood overflowed from it.
Chu Wuji crossed the threshold.
"Boom——"
The stone door closed, and the noise of the crowd was instantly isolated.
In the center of the secret room, a Ouija board floats quietly.
The surface of the disk is ancient, with intertwined runes and patterns, exuding a faint multicolored halo.
Next to him, a Qi Master was sitting on a futon, meditating with his eyes closed, his expression indifferent, and his light blue robe spotless.
"Hand, put it up."
The immortal master didn't open his eyes, he said something calmly, and then raised his chin slightly, indicating that he would place his hand on the spirit board.
Chu Wuji took a step closer, stretched out his arm, and put his palm against the soul measuring board.
A cold breath penetrated from the palm of his hand.
"Quietly guide the energy, and redirect the spiritual energy into the plate."
The immortal master said calmly, "Don't be nervous. The more nervous you are, the slower you will go."
Chu Wuji's throat tightened: "I...I don't know how."
The immortal master finally opened his eyes, and his half-closed gaze fell on his face, obviously troubled: "Do as I say: think of the breath in your chest, follow the arm to the palm, and send it back."
